title: Special Height and Setback Limitations
previewText: The provisions of this Section, inclusive, shall apply to buildings utilizing the sky exposure plane provisions of this Chapter. In no event shall such provisions apply to buildings that utilize the residential height and setback regulations of Section 23-40 (HEIGHT AND SETBACK REGULATIONS), inclusive, as modified by the provisions of Section 35-60 (MODIFICATION OF HEIGHT AND SETBACK REGULATIONS).
